comments.value: @{58c6d558ff44e44ada717902|full_name}: Can't wait ^^! Thanks for considering this idea.
@{5a0ce6b6bbb62e79ca0a94db|full_name}: Only issue I can see is walking and running animation not looking good while matching up with the analogue movement speed

Honestly, I would prefer if they swapped (or had an option to swap) the controls for movement/turning with the controls for hand/finger gestures. I really get annoyed about always having my fingers go into some weird pose when I just want to walk or move a bit, and I have to keep pressing the trigger or side buttons to get my hands back to normal EVERY time. It really makes my fingers sore from it, because I have small hands and the controller feels big already.

@{59e59c1cda46f215cddef5f6|full_name}: A change log on a previous updated stated that "Hand gesture should reset to default when user removes finger from vive pad [Community Request]". When I pressed them on the matter, they confirmed that, despite being in the change log, they never actually implemented the feature.
Can you guys do this for turning too?
@{58c6b8f8227a56787575ebc0|full_name}: You could not have it fully analogue, but snapping to either sprint or walk
@{5a3d20b15ebc1a73be59f2e3|full_name}: That's true - Personally I would prefer a toggle but it would be a good solution.
but what about for people with broken vive controllers?

@{5a1eced2c14f924f21845e35|full_name}: It strikes me as weird that people bring this up so often, considering I have never heard of other video games adding features to accommodate broken hardware. Regardless, if having crappy digital movement is considered to be important for these users, then it could always be implemented as a toggleable option.
@{5980059a0f0b831904883973|full_name}: well yeah thats what i meant. an option to have touch locomotion on and off through the system menu or something. :/
@{58c6b8f8227a56787575ebc0|full_name}: The transition between running and walking looks good on the rifts thumb stick. So dont worry. What I want now is analog turning, too.
I always thought it would be cool to have locomotion control via arm swinging that way the usual movement controls could be used for making more jestures
I would really, deeply prefer onward style movement. Headlook causes nausea for a lot of people. wand directed movement does not.
@{5a60e3832478a072c83fa7ce|full_name}: The feeling is mutual. Although, I highly doubt we will see movement controls of that level of sophistication in the near future in VRChat.
@{5980059a0f0b831904883973|full_name}: Imagine being able to look over your shoulder when playing Steel and Gold? One day...

@{58c6b8f8227a56787575ebc0|full_name}: I personally can't take games like Steel n' Gold and CTF in VRChat seriously with the crappy VRChat movement controls. When I am looking to play a game, I'd rather play a different VR game with better controls.

@{5a60e3832478a072c83fa7ce|full_name}: Would be cool. But to be honest if I am just roaming around and don't play games I sit in a chair or the floor most of the time. But for CTF it would be a nice addition.
@{58c6b3cc227a56787575ebb4|full_name}: I'm standing nearly 100% of the time when I'm playing unless I'm actually sitting in the game, I know many vr users that do the same.
This is currently in Beta! For those who have beta, please check it out.
Please add an option to turn this off.
Variable movement speed on Vive has been implemented as of v0.12.0p13, marking as complete.

details: When using Vive Wands, you are locked to sprint. Would it be better if we could click the trackpad once to walk, or click twice to sprint?
title: Vive Wand Movement Speed Control
